name: Classified Note: The Lunchbox Protocol
hint: Inspect the confidential reports thoroughly in the lab.
content: Secret Discovery #1: Institute telemetry confirms the Creator intentionally brought extra sandwiches just to watch Subject steal them with that guilty grin.

name: Declassified Exhibit: The Doodle Masterpiece
hint: Inspect Exhibit 5546 in the photo archive.
content: Secret Discovery #2: The marker doodles on the video call were preserved in high definition. Every single dot was confirmed as an emblem of chaotic honor.

name: The Hidden Plaque Behind Trophy #05
hint: Examine the base of the PGli Gawar Special Recognition Award.
content: Secret Discovery #3: An engraving reads: 'She thinks she is being roasted, but every single award was crafted with pure reverence.'

name: The Unsent Message In Orbit
hint: Look beneath the telescope telemetry in the observatory.
content: Secret Discovery #4: A cosmic whisper captured by observatory sensors: 'May her life be ten times more wonderful than her wildest dreams.'

name: Architect's Dedication Seal
hint: Examine the cornerstone pillar of the Grand Atrium.
content: Secret Discovery #5: The foundational cornerstone inscription reads: 'This institute was built not for science, but because one school friend meant the world to me.'
